title: NFT Cromos
tagline: An NFT game of trading and skill that leverages AR and hand motion recognition

prizes.placement: 🥇 OP Games - Best HTML5 Games using BuildQuest Sponsor SDKs / APIs
prizes.title: Outplay Games

description:
This project leveraged AR and hand motion recognition to pair players in a battle for each other's NFTs. The players take turns placing their NFTs on top of each other on a flat surface, they then use their hands to slap over the NFTs in an attempt to make them flip in the air. Whichever NFTs flip the active player gets to keep. The battle goes on until the players call it quits. 



For the build pipeline we use gitpod to make the project easily accessible to any developer with min system and install prep time.
how_its_made: The project is developed in React with React-three Fiber React-three cannon, Three.js, and WebXR to make it more accessible. It uses MedisPipes for the hand recognition system. It uses Moralis technology to handle all Web3 NFT transactions. =========================================================
